description: Devoted Druid + Swift Reconfiguration: enchanted Devoted Druid stops being a creature (Layer 4 type change), so its own -1/-1-counter untap ability never triggers the toughness-0 state-based action — validates INT-0002 as a real, repeatable infinite-green-mana loop, not an assumed one.
artificial_state_elements: Mana base: 2 Forest + 1 Plains are arbitrary scaffolding, not the subject deck's actual land base or mana curve — only enough {W} to cast Swift Reconfiguration once was material.
No other permanents, hand cards, or players' boards were modeled — this is a two-card isolation test, not a representative game state.
Loop was run a fixed 5 times (not to any natural stopping point) purely to demonstrate non-termination within a bounded, checkable range; the test framework has no unbounded-loop assertion.
material_characteristics: Devoted Druid's exact activated-ability costs and effects (mana ability + -1/-1-counter untap ability)
Swift Reconfiguration's exact type-changing effect ('loses all other card types', becomes a Vehicle artifact, 'not a creature unless crewed')
The Layer 4 type-change timing relative to state-based action checks (CR 613.1d, 704.5f)
That -1/-1 counters may still be placed on a non-creature permanent (CR 121) without a P/T-reduction effect to apply to
abstracted_characteristics: Mana source identity (any producer of {W} for the one-time Swift Reconfiguration cast would do)
All board state not directly involved in the two-card interaction
Turn/phase beyond what's needed to cast one spell and activate abilities repeatedly in a single main phase

legal_actions: Cast Swift Reconfiguration targeting Devoted Druid
After Swift Reconfiguration resolves: activate Devoted Druid's mana ability ({T}: Add {G})
Activate Devoted Druid's untap ability (put a -1/-1 counter on it: untap it) — repeatable without limit
illegal_actions_to_reject: Any implicit assumption that Devoted Druid dies once total -1/-1 counters exceed its printed toughness (2) — it does not, because it is not a creature while enchanted by Swift Reconfiguration
expected.outcome_if_resolved: After 5 loop iterations: Devoted Druid still on the battlefield (not in graveyard), carrying 5 -1/-1 counters, type Artifact (not Creature), with 5 {G} in the player's mana pool. The loop has no natural termination and could be run an arbitrary number of times within the same priority window.

rules_citations: CR 704.5f (state-based action: 0-or-less-toughness creature to graveyard — applies only to creatures)
CR 121 (counters may be placed on any permanent, not creature-restricted)
